CustomField.description: Deduplication key for invitation processing: 18-character Event Instance Id + ':' + 18-character Contact Id (or Lead Id when there is no Contact). Blank when the Registration has no Contact or Lead. Maintained by InvitationRegistrationDedupe; do not edit manually.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Prevents more than one invitation Registration per person per Event Instance. Set by automation.
CustomField.label: Invitation Key
